rdfs:label: hasTelephone
rdfs:comment: A telephone number associated with the subject — typically a `tel:` IRI.
notes: Use a `tel:` URI (e.g. `tel:+44-20-1234-5678`) for the value, not a bare string. Repeat for multiple numbers. For typed numbers (work/home/mobile), the value can be a node typed `vcard:Cell`/`vcard:Voice`/`vcard:Fax` (+ `vcard:Home`/`vcard:Work`) carrying `vcard:value <tel:...>` (vcard:Tel is deprecated upstream). Not `urn:solid:telephone` (schema.org, plain string).

history.note: Replaced deprecated vcard:Tel guidance with TelephoneType-typed node; added urn:solid:telephone to notToBeConfusedWith.
